Hand-authored final.hi.html + final.hi.css, reusing biology-12-3's own build_page/latex2html template. Surveyed this chapter's own math spans (a real step up from biology-12-2/3 - genotype/allele notation with nested sub/superscripts, ratio notation, \left/\right delimiters) and found only one genuinely new command needed: \varphi, mapped to the same phi glyph \phi already used (a stylistic LaTeX variant of the same Greek letter, not a different one). Two Greek-letter symbols ($\boldsymbol{\sigma}$, $\boldsymbol{\varphi}$ in q_4.8) that probably represent OCR'd male/female (♂/♀) biological symbols were rendered exactly as extracted (literal Greek glyphs), not reinterpreted - stage 9 templates the JSON's own judgment calls, it doesn't make new ones about what an ambiguous symbol 'really' means. This chapter's mixed multi-part content shape (q_4.2/q_4.13 with per-part solutions, q_4.7 without) was confirmed to already work correctly via the existing per-item parts_have_content branch, no code change needed. First chapter to exercise render_table() for real content (dominance/recessiveness comparison, blood-group Punnett-square cross) - both serialized and rendered correctly, cell content verbatim. Two real rendering bugs caught and fixed during pre-finish checks, both now fixed in build_page_bio4.py for future reuse: (1) a literal backslash-escaped '\&'/'\%' sitting in PLAIN prose (outside any $...$ math span, e.g. '(Dominance \& Recessiveness)', 'जनकीय अनुपात 100\%') leaked the raw backslash onto the page, since the plain-text esc() path only HTML-escapes and never runs the LaTeX converter that would otherwise consume that backslash - fixed by un-escaping '\&'/'\%' back to plain characters before HTML-escaping. (2) the sentence-per-line splitter's decimal-point guard didn't protect an abbreviation dot between capital letters (e.g. 'I.Q.', 'T.H.') from being treated as a sentence boundary - 'इनका I.Q. स्तर...' tore into three separate lines ('इनका I.' / 'Q.' / 'स्तर...') before the fix; added a guard for a '.' immediately preceded by a single uppercase ASCII letter, verified it also correctly fixes 'T.H. Morgan' elsewhere in the same chapter without introducing any new page-count/line-count regression. Pre-finish checks: all 11 figure srcs resolve; lang=hi present; zero leaked raw LaTeX text; zero literal backslashes; 23 question/final_answer fields read back against the rendered HTML, 0 missing; manually spot-read q_4.2 (table + mixed concept labels), q_4.12 (table + corrected genotype notation), q_4.16 (two-disorder figure placement), and q_4.8 (the sigma/varphi symbols) directly in the rendered output - all correct.
